canonical_reaction_rates.interpretation: stationary conditional expectations; populations alone are not asserted Markov

formal_canonical_spatial_reference.distance: shortest-path distance on the supplied face-dual graph, not causal or branchial distance
formal_canonical_spatial_reference.scope: stationary face-class pairs only; does not exclude transient pairing or correlations of larger loop observables

relaxation.schedule_convention: Python random.Random(run.seed).randrange(49 * rooted_fan_count), iid attempts; sha256 uses little-endian uint32
relaxation.measurement: all post-attempt states after burn, including idle attempts; uncertainty across independently seeded run means, not iid ticks

scope: Finite classical gauge-link dynamics on a supplied torus under iid uniform rule/placement sampling; coarse stationary weights are not full gauge-orbit counts.
